mode-30m.title: 30 metres
mode-30m.prompt: Choose an emission that's legal on 10.120 MHz.
mode-30m.success: CW or FT8: 30 m is narrow and bans SSB.

atv-band.title: Television
atv-band.prompt: Your fast-scan TV is on 145 MHz. Move it to a band where it's legal.
hints: 2 m is limited to 30 kHz. Try 70 cm.
atv-band.success: On 70 cm, around 430 to 450 MHz, there's room for a 6 MHz TV signal.

band-edge.title: The band edge
band-edge.prompt: Move down until your whole USB signal is inside 20 m.
band-edge.success: USB extends about 3 kHz above the carrier, so 14.347 MHz is the highest legal carrier.
